slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Our technicians securely access your systems from anywhere to resolve issues quickly, from software errors and updates to security alerts and connectivity problems. No waiting for a visit, fast responses, minimal disruption and constant access to expert help. When something needs hands on hardware, engineers travel from our London and Stevenage offices across Hertfordshire and the capital.

slots.default: Hands-on help at your premises for anything that needs physical attention: hardware installation, server maintenance, network setup and complex troubleshooting. An engineer can be on site when hardware needs hands on it.
